mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees and overcast at Verona City Hall with an air quality index of 53, and while the space station will be passing overhead tonight, the cloud cover means it will not be visible.

The city has announced that Highway M will be closed near the new Aldi site from October 6 to October 9 for road work, and residents are reminded that early voting for the November 3 election begins with specific hours at City Hall starting October 20.
Enjoy a busy week with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga, the downtown farmer's market, and music at Paddy Mac's occurring tomorrow.
On September 24, a vehicle and bicyclist collision occurred, but fortunately, the 11-year-old cyclist did not require hospital transport.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and with the restaurant currently open until 10 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
